p: Most people walk in nervous and walk out grinning. If it's your first time, a few tips will help you get there faster.
Look ahead. Karts go where your eyes go, so look through each corner to where you want to come out, not at the kart in front. It feels odd at first, but it makes a massive difference.

Brake before the bend, not in the middle of it. Do your slowing down in a straight line, turn in, then gently get back on the power as you straighten up. Avoid pressing both pedals at once, as it only slows you down.
Use the whole track. Enter corners wide, cut in to clip the inside, then let the kart run out wide again on the exit. It straightens the corner and lets you carry more speed.
Relax your grip and sit back. Tense arms tire quickly, and smooth steering is quicker than jerky movements.
Book ahead at weekends, when slots fill up fast with parties.

Preston's position makes it easy to reach, with the M6 and M55 close by and good rail links on the West Coast Main Line. That makes it a handy meeting point for groups from across Lancashire, Blackpool and the Lakes. Afterwards, the riverside parks are lovely for a stroll, and Preston's covered markets are well worth a look.
